sourceText: Style you wear. Culture you carry.

scope.definition: Every current alpha-2 entry represented in the Library of Congress ISO 639 table.
scope.limitation: ISO 639-1 is not every human language and does not resolve every dialect or script.

editorialContract.meaning: Style is personal expression worn through clothing; culture is lived identity carried with the person.
editorialContract.syntax: Prefer two short balanced native clauses; adapt word order and ellipsis when required by the language.
editorialContract.publication: This catalog may be public only as a visibly labeled working draft. No localized line is approved brand copy until a native copywriter records target-market approval.

translations.translation: Atu sarittah tan maagaxxi. Atu isillih quuktah tan qaada.
translations.note: Broad Afar form; native review required.

translations.translation: Уара иушәҵәо астиль. Уара иуцу акультура.
translations.transliteration: Uara iušəc̄o astil’. Uara iucu akul’tura.
translations.note: Masculine singular; standard loan nouns; native review required.

translations.translation: Styl wat jy dra. Kultuur wat jy saamdra.
translations.note: Informal singular; saamdra conveys carrying within or along.

translations.translation: Atadehyɛ a wohyɛ. Amammerɛ a wosoa.
translations.note: ISO ak represented through explicitly labeled Asante Twi; other Akan varieties require separate review.

translations.translation: Stili që ti vesh. Kultura që ti mbart.
translations.note: Informal singular; explicit ti prevents subject ambiguity.

translations.translation: የሚለብሱት ዘይቤ። የሚሸከሙት ባህል።
translations.transliteration: Yämiläbsut zäybē. Yämishäkkämut bahəl.
translations.note: Polite or plural generic you; native copy review advised.

translations.translation: أسلوب ترتديه. ثقافة تحملها معك.
translations.transliteration: Uslūb tartadīh. Thaqāfa taḥmiluhā maʿak.
translations.note: Modern Standard Arabic; generic masculine singular.

translations.translation: O estilo que vistes. A cultura que portas.
translations.note: Standard Aragonese; native review advised.

translations.translation: Ոճ, որ կրում ես։ Մշակույթ, որ կրում ես։
translations.transliteration: Voch, vor krum es. Mshakuyt, vor krum es.
translations.note: Eastern Armenian; the same verb creates native wordplay.

translations.translation: আপুনি পিন্ধা শৈলী। আপুনি কঢ়িয়াই নিয়া সংস্কৃতি।
translations.transliteration: Āpuni pindhā śailī. Āpuni kaṛhiyāi niyā saṃskṛti.
translations.note: Formal singular; balanced participial clauses.

translations.translation: Нужеца ретӀунеб къагӀида. Нужеца баччулеб маданият.
translations.transliteration: Nužeca ret’uneb qag’ida. Nužeca baččuleb madanijat.
translations.note: Polite or plural; native lexemes used; native review advised.

translations.translation: 𐬗𐬌𐬚𐬭𐬆𐬨 𐬫𐬀𐬝 𐬬𐬀𐬯𐬙𐬈. 𐬛𐬀𐬉𐬥𐬁 𐬫𐬄𐬨 𐬠𐬀𐬭𐬀𐬌𐬙𐬌.
translations.transliteration: ciθrəm yaṱ vaste. daēnā yąm baraiti.
translations.note: Scholarly reconstruction using generic one; culture approximated by daēnā; expert philological review mandatory.

translations.translation: Estilo ukax isimp isthapt’atawa. Sarawi ukax jumamp chika apt’atawa.
translations.note: Bolivian unified orthography; sarawi means lived cultural practice; native review required.

translations.translation: Geyindiyin üslub. Daşıdığın mədəniyyət.
translations.note: Informal singular; concise native syntax.

translations.translation: Һин кейгән стиль. Һин йөрөткән мәҙәниәт.
translations.transliteration: Hin keygän stil’. Hin yörötkän mäźäniät.
translations.note: Informal singular; established loan nouns; native copy review advised.

translations.translation: Cogo min na i bɛ fini don. Laada min b’i ta n’i ye.
translations.note: Style transcreated as way of dressing and culture as tradition; native review required.

translations.translation: Janzten duzun estiloa. Zurekin daramazun kultura.
translations.note: Neutral singular; daramazun means carrying with you.

translations.translation: Стыль, які носіш. Культура, якую нясеш.
translations.transliteration: Styĺ, jaki nosiš. Kuĺtura, jakuju niasieš.
translations.note: Informal singular; distinct wear and carry verbs.

translations.translation: যে শৈলী তুমি পরো। যে সংস্কৃতি তুমি বহন করো।
translations.transliteration: Je śailī tumi paro. Je saṃskṛti tumi bahan karo.
translations.note: Informal singular; exact balanced relative clauses.

translations.translation: Stael we yu werem. Kastom we yu karem.
translations.note: Kastom conveys lived culture and heritage.

translations.translation: Stil koji nosiš. Kultura koju nosiš.
translations.note: Informal singular; the same verb creates native wordplay.

translations.translation: Ar stil a wiskez. Ar sevenadur a zougez.
translations.note: Informal singular; expected relative-clause mutations; native review advised.

translations.translation: Стилът, който носиш. Културата, която носиш.
translations.transliteration: Stilǎt, kojto nosiš. Kulturata, kojato nosiš.
translations.note: Informal singular; носиш naturally carries both senses.

translations.nativeName: မြန်မာဘာသာ
translations.translation: သင်ဝတ်ဆင်သည့် ဟန်ပန်။ သင်သယ်ဆောင်သည့် ယဉ်ကျေးမှု။
translations.transliteration: Thin wut hsin thi han pan. Thin thae hsaung thi yin kyae hmu.
translations.note: Literary and formal register; native copy review advised.

translations.translation: L’estil que portes. La cultura que portes dins.
translations.note: Cross-variety wording; dins makes the embodied sense explicit.

translations.translation: I estilu ni’ un usa. I kuttura ni’ un chule’ gi halom-mu.
translations.note: Guam CHamoru orthography; established Hispanic loans; native review required.

translations.translation: Ахь лелош йолу стиль. Ахь хьайца дӀакхоьхьуш йолу культура.
translations.transliteration: Aẋ leloš yolu stil’. Aẋ ẋayca d’aqöẋuš yolu kul’tura.
translations.note: Informal singular; established loans; native review required.

translations.translation: 风格穿在身上，文化带在心中。
translations.transliteration: Fēnggé chuān zài shēnshang, wénhuà dài zài xīnzhōng.
translations.note: Simplified standard Mandarin; idiomatic balanced transcreation.

translations.translation: Ѡбразъ, єгоже носиши. Преданіе, єже въ себѣ носиши.
translations.transliteration: Obrazŭ, jegože nosiši. Predanije, ježe vŭ sebě nosiši.
translations.note: Russian recension; culture transcreated as tradition; expert liturgical-language review mandatory.

translations.translation: Эсӗ тӑхӑнакан стиль. Эсӗ илсе ҫӳрекен культура.
translations.transliteration: Esĕ tăhănakan stil’. Esĕ ilse çüreken kul’tura.
translations.note: Informal singular; established loans; native review advised.

translations.translation: An gis a wiskydh. An gonisogeth a dhegedh.
translations.note: Standard Written Form; gis is native style or fashion; native review advised.

translations.translation: Stile chì porti. Cultura chì porti cun tè.
translations.note: Informal singular; balanced repetition; speaker polish advised.

translations.translation: kikiska kitisinâkosiwin. pimohtata kitisîhcikêwin.
translations.note: Plains Cree SRO; imperative ‘wear your look’; native approval essential.

translations.translation: Styl, který nosíš. Kultura, kterou v sobě neseš.
translations.note: Informal singular; ‘within yourself’ conveys embodiment.

translations.translation: Stil, du bærer. Kultur, du bærer med dig.
translations.note: Informal singular; bære wordplay preserved.

translations.translation: ތިބާ ލާ ސްޓައިލް. ތިބާ ގެންގުޅޭ ސަގާފަތް.
translations.transliteration: Thibaa laa staail. Thibaa gengulhey sagaafaiy.
translations.note: Standard Malé Dhivehi; established style loan; native review needed.

translations.translation: Stijl die je draagt. Cultuur die je uitdraagt.
translations.note: Informal singular; uitdragen means embody or express.

translations.translation: ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་གྱོན་པའི་བཟོ་རྣམ། ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་འབག་པའི་ལམ་སྲོལ།
translations.transliteration: khyod kyis gyon pa'i bzo rnam. khyod kyis 'bag pa'i lam srol.
translations.note: Standard Dzongkha; Wylie transliteration; native review essential.

translations.translation: Style you wear. Culture you carry.
translations.note: Canonical source wording.

translations.translation: Stilo, kiun vi portas. Kulturo, kiun vi kunportas.
translations.note: Kunporti means carry along or with oneself.

translations.translation: Stiil, mida kannad. Kultuur, mida endas kannad.
translations.note: Informal singular; endas makes embodiment explicit.

translations.translation: Atsia si nèdo lá. Dekɔnu si nètsɔ lá.
translations.note: Standard Ewe practical orthography; tone and slogan rhythm merit review.

translations.translation: Stílur, sum tú ber. Mentan, sum tú ber við tær.
translations.note: Informal singular; bera wordplay preserved.

translations.translation: Na ivakarau o daramaka. Na itovo vakavanua o kauta voli.
translations.note: Standard Bauan Fijian; kauta voli conveys carrying onward or along.

translations.translation: Tyyli, jota kannat. Kulttuuri, jota kannat mukanasi.
translations.note: Literary kannat sustains the wear/carry wordplay.

translations.translation: Le style que tu portes. La culture que tu incarnes.
translations.note: Tutoiement; incarnes avoids a physical-hauling interpretation.

translations.translation: Styl dy'tsto draachst. Kultuer dy'tsto útdraachst.
translations.note: Informal singular; útdrage means embody or express.

translations.translation: Ɓorno moodu maa. Ronndo finaa-tawaa maa.
translations.note: Fuuta Jaloo Pular Latin chosen; imperative transcreation; native review essential.

translations.translation: სტილი, რომელსაც ატარებ. კულტურა, რომელსაც თან ატარებ.
translations.transliteration: Stili, romelsats atareb. Kultura, romelsats tan atareb.
translations.note: Informal singular; თან supplies the ‘with you’ sense.

translations.translation: Stil, den du trägst. Kultur, die du in dir trägst.
translations.note: Informal singular; in dir conveys lived identity.

translations.translation: Stoidhle a chaitheas tu. Cultar a ghiùlaineas tu leat.
translations.note: Informal singular; habitual relative forms; speaker polish advised.

translations.translation: Stíl a chaitheann tú. Cultúr a iompraíonn tú leat.
translations.note: Informal singular; natural wear/carry contrast.

translations.translation: Estilo que levas. Cultura que levas contigo.
translations.note: Informal singular; levar repetition sounds natural.

translations.translation: Aght t'ou ceau. Cultoor t'ou gymmyrkey mayrt.
translations.note: Modern standard Manx; mayrt means ‘with you’; speaker review advised.

translations.translation: Στιλ που φοράς. Κουλτούρα που κουβαλάς.
translations.transliteration: Stil pou forás. Koultúra pou kouvalás.
translations.note: Informal singular; standard loans; internal rhyme preserved.

translations.translation: Estílo remondéva. Arandupy regueraháva nendive.
translations.note: Standard Paraguayan Guaraní; established style loan; speaker review advised.

translations.translation: તમારી શૈલી પહેરો. તમારી સંસ્કૃતિ સાથે લઈને ચાલો.
translations.transliteration: Tamārī śailī pahero. Tamārī saṃskr̥ti sāthe laīne cālo.
translations.note: Polite imperative transcreation; native campaign cadence still requires review.

translations.translation: Stil ou mete. Kilti ou pote.
translations.note: Direct, balanced colloquial syntax.

translations.translation: Salon da kuke sanyawa. Al’adun da kuke ɗauke da su.
translations.note: Respectful or plural generic ‘you’; plural culture agreement.

translations.translation: סגנון שאתם לובשים. תרבות שאתם נושאים איתכם.
translations.transliteration: Signon she’atem lovshim. Tarbut she’atem nos’im itchem.
translations.note: Generic masculine plural; gender-neutral infinitive variant possible.

translations.translation: Omuhingo mbu mo zara. Ombazu ndji mo twara pamwe na ove.
translations.note: Standard Otjiherero; relative-concord draft; native approval essential.

translations.translation: पहनें अपना अंदाज़। साथ लेकर चलें अपनी संस्कृति।
translations.transliteration: Pahneṁ apnā andāz. Sāth lekar caleṁ apnī saṃskr̥ti.
translations.note: Polite imperative transcreation.

translations.translation: Oiemu dabua dekenai, oiemu toana. Oiemu kudouna dekenai, bese ena kara.
translations.note: Papuan standard; transcreated as style in clothing, people’s way in heart; native review required.

translations.translation: Stil koji nosiš. Kultura koju nosiš sa sobom.
translations.note: Informal singular; sa sobom preserves culture carried with oneself without implying dissemination.

translations.translation: A stílus, amit viselsz. A kultúra, amit hordozol.
translations.note: Informal singular; hordozol naturally conveys bearing and embodying.

translations.translation: Ụdị ejiji ị na-eyi. Omenala ị na-ebu.
translations.note: Ụdị ejiji specifies personal dress style; native copy review advised.

translations.translation: Stíllinn sem þú klæðist. Menningin sem þú berð með þér.
translations.note: Natural informal singular; klæðast governs clothing sense.

translations.translation: La stilo quan tu portas. La kulturo quan tu portas.
translations.note: Portar supports wear and bear; deliberate repetition preserves balance.

translations.translation: ꆏꃢꈜꎔꈚ。ꆏꆈꌠꋊꃤꌌ。
translations.transliteration: Ne vit gga nrat ggat. Ne Nuosu cyt vi sip.
translations.note: Standard Liangshan Yi; transcreated as beautiful dress and Nuosu lineage; native review required.

translations.translation: ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᓂᖓ ᐊᑐᖅᑕᐃᑦ. ᐃᓕᖅᑯᓯᖅ ᓇᒃᓴᖅᑕᐃᑦ.
translations.transliteration: Aaqqiksimaninga atuqtait. Iliqqusiq naksaqtait.
translations.note: Nunavut syllabics; morphology and culture term checked, native slogan review advised.

translations.translation: Li stil quel tu porta. Li cultura quel tu porta.
translations.note: Modern Interlingue; parallel use of portar preserves wordplay.

translations.translation: Le stilo que tu porta. Le cultura que tu porta.
translations.note: Natural parallel Romance syntax; portare covers wear and carry.

translations.translation: Gaya yang kaukenakan. Budaya yang kaubawa.
translations.note: Concise informal singular; exact balanced relative-clause syntax.

translations.translation: Irrusiq atiġiñ. Iḷitqusiq tigummiġiñ.
translations.note: Imperative transcreation: wear style, hold culture; North Alaskan spelling; native review required.

translations.translation: Lo stile che indossi. La cultura che porti con te.
translations.note: Native, concise, informal singular; con te keeps figurative carrying clear.

translations.translation: Gaya sing kokanggo. Kabudayan sing kokgawa.
translations.note: Standard Latin-script ngoko; intimate direct-address register.

translations.translation: 身にまとうスタイル。心に宿す文化。
translations.transliteration: Mi ni matou sutairu. Kokoro ni yadosu bunka.
translations.note: Native fashion phrasing: style on body, culture dwelling in heart.

translations.translation: Atisalersoriaatsimik atuisarputit. Piorsarsimassutsimik tigummiartarputit.
translations.note: Standard West Greenlandic; native compounds avoid Danish culture/style loans; review cadence with native copywriter.

translations.translation: ನೀವು ಧರಿಸುವ ಶೈಲಿ. ನೀವು ಹೊತ್ತೊಯ್ಯುವ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ.
translations.transliteration: Nīvu dharisuva śaili. Nīvu hottōyyuva saṃskr̥ti.
translations.note: Respectful second person; ಹೊತ್ತೊಯ್ಯುವ suggests carrying onward.

translations.translation: پۄشاکَس مَنٛز اَنٛداز۔ دِلَس مَنٛز تَہذیٖب۔
translations.transliteration: Pōshākas manz andāz. Dilas manz tahzīb.
translations.note: Perso-Arabic standard; gender-neutral transcreation: style in dress, culture in heart; native review required.

translations.translation: Fasal do sǝkǝna dǝ. Ada do gozana dǝ.
translations.note: Yerwa Central Kanuri in Latin orthography; ISO macrolanguage choice; native review required.

translations.translation: Киетін стилің. Бойыңда алып жүретін мәдениетің.
translations.transliteration: Kietin stiliñ. Boıyñda alyp jüretin mädenietiñ.
translations.note: Balanced noun phrases; бойыңда makes culture embodied within; native slogan review required.

translations.translation: រចនាប័ទ្មដែលអ្នកពាក់។ វប្បធម៌ដែលអ្នកយកតាមខ្លួន។
translations.transliteration: Rôchnâbât dael neak peăk. Vôppôthoăm dael neak yôk tam khluŏn.
translations.note: Formal native style term; second clause explicitly means carry with oneself.

translations.translation: Mũtindo ũrĩa wĩhumbaga. Mũtugo ũrĩa ũkuaga.
translations.note: Central Gĩkũyũ; mũtindo is established regional style term; native review required.

translations.translation: Imiterere wambara. Umuco witwaza.
translations.note: Concise singular; witwaza means carry with oneself, including figuratively.

translations.translation: Сен кийген стиль. Боюңда алып жүргөн маданият.
translations.transliteration: Sen kiygen stil. Boyuñda alyp jürgön madaniyat.
translations.note: Informal singular; second clause means culture carried within oneself.

translations.translation: Стиль тэ новлан. Культура тэ нуан.
translations.transliteration: Stil te novlan. Kultura te nuan.
translations.note: Standard Komi-Zyrian; Russian-derived nouns are established usage; native cadence review advised.

translations.translation: Mutindu uvwata. Kinkulu unata.
translations.note: Conservative central Kikongo rather than separate Kituba; macrolanguage variation requires native-market review.

translations.translation: 입는 스타일. 지니는 문화.
translations.transliteration: Imneun seutail. Jinineun munhwa.
translations.note: Compact slogan syntax; 지니다 conveys carrying, possessing, and embodying.

translations.translation: Oto djala nonghedi. Oto humbata omufyuululwakalo.
translations.note: Namibian Oshikwanyama orthography; transcreated as dress with style, carry heritage; native review required.

translations.translation: Şêwaza ku tu li xwe dikî. Çanda ku tu bi xwe re dibî.
translations.note: Kurmanji Latin chosen as widest-recognized written variety; Sorani needs separate localization.

translations.translation: ແບບທີ່ເຈົ້ານຸ່ງໃສ່. ວັດທະນະທຳທີ່ເຈົ້າພົກພາ.
translations.transliteration: Bǣp thī chao nung sai. Vatthanatham thī chao phok pha.
translations.note: Native style term avoids English loan; ພົກພາ means carry along.

translations.translation: Stilum geris. Culturam tecum fers.
translations.note: Modern Latin senses; geris versus fers preserves wear/carry distinction.

translations.translation: Stils, ko valkā. Kultūra, ko nes sevī.
translations.note: Natural generic second person; ‘carry within.’

translations.translation: Stiel dae se dräögs. Kultuur die se mitdräögs.
translations.note: Central/Veldeke-style draft; no unified standard; local-dialect review required.

translations.translation: Lolenge oyo olataka. Mimeseno oyo omemaka.
translations.note: Mimeseno conveys lived customs/culture; fluent review advised.

translations.translation: Stilius, kurį dėvi. Kultūra, kurią nešiojiesi savyje.
translations.note: Natural; second clause means ‘carry within yourself.’

translations.translation: Stil, deen s du dréis. Kultur, déi s du mat dir dréis.
translations.note: Standard orthography; droen preserves wear/carry wordplay.

translations.translation: Muswelo ofwala. Kiluba kyosenda.
translations.note: Kiluba denotes Luba cultural identity; tone and native syntax review required.

translations.translation: Omusono gw’oyambala. Obuwangwa bw’otwala.
translations.note: Native noun-class agreement; brand-copy review advised.

translations.translation: Стил што го носиш. Култура што ја носиш.
translations.transliteration: Stil što go nosiš. Kultura što ja nosiš.
translations.note: Носиш naturally preserves wear/carry wordplay.

translations.translation: Wāween kōṇak eo aṃ. Manit eo kwōj bōk ippam.
translations.note: Modern orthography; first clause transcreated as ‘your way of dressing’; native review required.

translations.translation: നിങ്ങൾ അണിയുന്ന ശൈലി. നിങ്ങൾ ഉള്ളിലേറ്റുന്ന സംസ്കാരം.
translations.transliteration: Niṅṅaḷ aṇiyunna śaili. Niṅṅaḷ uḷḷilēṟṟunna saṃskāraṃ.
translations.note: Second clause means culture carried within.

translations.translation: Te kāhua e mau nei i a koe. Te ahurea e kawe nei koe.
translations.note: Natural active/stative contrast; fluent Māori review advised.

translations.translation: तुम्ही परिधान करता ती शैली. तुम्ही मनात बाळगता ती संस्कृती.
translations.transliteration: Tumhī paridhān karatā tī śailī. Tumhī manāt bāḷagatā tī saṃskr̥tī.
translations.note: Second clause means ‘culture you carry in your heart.’

translations.translation: Gaya yang anda pakai. Budaya yang anda bawa.
translations.note: Standard neutral Malay; direct balanced syntax.

translations.translation: Ny fomba fitafinao. Ny kolontsaina entinao.
translations.note: First clause transcreated as ‘your style of dress’; review regional register.

translations.translation: Stil li tilbes. Kultura li ġġorr.
translations.note: Concise native syntax; exact wear/carry contrast.

translations.translation: Таны өмсдөг хэв маяг. Таны тээж явдаг соёл.
translations.transliteration: Tany ömsdög khev mayag. Tany teej yavdag soyol.
translations.note: Standard Khalkha Cyrillic; ‘carry along’ signals embodied culture.

translations.translation: Aren am ekarawin. Ôbù am deden.
translations.note: Provisional ‘your dress style; carry your customs’; orthography and grammar require Nauruan review.
No defensible generic Diné bizaad expression found; Hózhǫ́ substitution rejected as culturally specific. Commission fluent Diné copy.

translations.translation: Isitayela osigqokako. Isiko oliphathako.
translations.note: South African isiNdebele relative ending -ko; native copy review advised.

translations.translation: Isitayila osigqokayo. Isiko oliphetheyo.
translations.note: Zimbabwean isiNdebele spelling and -yo relatives; native review advised.

translations.translation: Omutindo ngoka to zala. Omuthigululwakalo ngoka to humbata.
translations.note: Uses ‘cultural heritage’ for culture; Oshindonga review required.

translations.translation: तपाईंले लगाउने शैली। तपाईंले बोकेर हिँड्ने संस्कृति।
translations.transliteration: Tapāī̃le lagāune śailī. Tapāī̃le bokera hĩḍne saṃskr̥ti.
translations.note: Natural respectful second person; ‘carry as you go.’

translations.translation: Stilen du ber. Kulturen du ber med deg.
translations.note: Bere preserves wear/bear wordplay.

translations.translation: Stilen du bærer. Kulturen du bærer med deg.
translations.note: Literary-natural bære preserves wear/carry wordplay.

translations.translation: Stilen du bærer. Kulturen du bærer med deg.
translations.note: Macrolanguage has no separate written norm; Bokmål chosen as broad default.

translations.translation: Sitayilo imene mumavala. Chikhalidwe chimene mumanyamula.
translations.note: Sitayilo is established fashion usage; respectful/plural second person.

translations.translation: L’estil que pòrtas. La cultura que pòrtas dins tu.
translations.note: Classical orthography, Lengadocian-neutral; second clause means ‘within you.’

translations.translation: Gigishkigen gidoozhichigewin. Bimaadan gidinaadiziwin.
translations.note: Southwestern Ojibwe double-vowel; imperative transcreation; dialect and inflection review mandatory.

translations.translation: ଆପଣ ପିନ୍ଧୁଥିବା ଶୈଳୀ। ଆପଣ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ନେଇ ଚାଲୁଥିବା ସଂସ୍କୃତି।
translations.transliteration: Āpaṇa pindhuthibā śaiḷī. Āpaṇa sāṅgare nei cāluthibā saṃskr̥ti.
translations.note: Respectful second person; ‘carry along with you.’

translations.translation: Akkaataa isin itti uffattan. Aadaa isin baattan.
translations.note: Formal/plural gender-neutral ‘you’; native review advised for slogan cadence.

translations.translation: Стиль дарыс. Культурæ хæссыс.
translations.transliteration: Stilʹ darys. Kulʹturæ khæssys.
translations.note: Iron standard selected; concise SOV clauses; native review advised.

translations.translation: ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ ਪਹਿਨੋ। ਸੱਭਿਆਚਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਲੈ ਚੱਲੋ।
translations.transliteration: Andāz pahino. Sabbhiācār nāl lai challo.
translations.note: Gurmukhi selected; polite gender-neutral imperative.

translations.translation: سبکی که به تن می‌کنی. فرهنگی که با خود می‌بری.
translations.transliteration: Sabkī ke be tan mīkonī. Farhangī ke bā khod mībarī.
translations.note: Natural informal-singular slogan.

translations.translation: सकं वेसं परिदहसि। आचारं वहसि।
translations.transliteration: Sakaṃ vesaṃ paridahasi. Ācāraṃ vahasi.
translations.note: Devanagari selected among Pali’s multiple scripts; classical-language expert review required.

translations.translation: Styl, który nosisz. Kultura, którą niesiesz.
translations.note: Natural parallel construction; niesiesz supports embodied metaphor.

translations.translation: Estilo que vestes. Cultura que levas contigo.
translations.note: European Portuguese selected for Bisti’s France/Cabo Verde context; Brazilian Portuguese requires separate localization.

translations.translation: هغه طرز چې اغوندې؛ هغه کلتور چې له ځانه سره وړې.
translations.transliteration: Hagha tarz che aghwandē; hagha kaltūr che la dzāna sara wṛē.
translations.note: Standard Pashto script; informal singular.

translations.translation: P’achawan rikch’ayniyki rikuchiy. Kawsayniykita purichiy.
translations.note: Southern Quechua, Cusco-Collao; poetic ‘make your culture walk’; native review required.

translations.translation: Il stil che ti portas. La cultura che ti portas en tai.
translations.note: Supraregional Rumantsch Grischun selected; culture carried ‘within.’

translations.translation: Stilul pe care îl porți. Cultura pe care o porți cu tine.
translations.note: Latin-script Romanian standard, also used officially in Moldova.

translations.translation: Uburyo wambara. Umuco ugendana.
translations.note: Style transcreated as ‘the way you dress’; native slogan review required.

translations.translation: Стиль — на тебе. Культура — в тебе.
translations.transliteration: Stilʹ — na tebe. Kulʹtura — v tebe.
translations.note: Idiomatic body/identity contrast; avoids physical-hauling sense.

translations.translation: Yû mode tî mo. Bata culture tî mo na bê.
translations.note: ‘Keep your culture in your heart’; established French-derived terms; native review required.

translations.translation: स्वशैलीं परिदधासि। संस्कृतिं वहसि।
translations.transliteration: Svaśailīṃ paridadhāsi. Saṃskṛtiṃ vahasi.
translations.note: Grammatical poetic Sanskrit best effort; classical-language expert review advised.

translations.translation: ඔබ අඳින විලාසය. ඔබ දරාගෙන යන සංස්කෘතිය.
translations.transliteration: Oba andina vilāsaya. Oba darāgena yana saṃskṛtiya.
translations.note: Balanced relative clauses; native copy review advised.

translations.translation: Štýl nosíš na sebe. Kultúru nosíš v sebe.
translations.note: Native parallel: ‘on yourself / within yourself.’

translations.translation: Slog nosiš na sebi. Kulturo nosiš v sebi.
translations.note: Natural balanced body/identity construction.

translations.translation: Bivttastat iežat stilii. Guottát iežat kultuvrra.
translations.note: Standard Northern Sámi; inflection and slogan register need native review.

translations.translation: O lou sitaili e te ofuina. O lou aganuʻu e te tauaveina.
translations.note: Balanced modern Samoan; sitaili is an established loan.

translations.translation: Chimiro chaunopfeka. Tsika dzaunotakura.
translations.note: Style rendered as appearance; tsika conveys cultural customs.

translations.translation: انداز جيڪو اوهان پايو ٿا. ثقافت جيڪا اوهان سان گڏ هلي ٿي.
translations.transliteration: Andāz jeko ohān pāyo thā. Saqāfat jekā ohān sāṇ gaḍu halē thī.
translations.note: Standard Arabic-based Sindhi; culture rendered as accompanying you.

translations.translation: Qaabka aad u labisato. Dhaqanka aad xambaarsan tahay.
translations.note: Idiomatic: style as how you dress; culture as what you embody.

translations.translation: Setaele seo u se aparang. Setso seo u se jarang.
translations.note: Setaele is established usage; native review advised for figurative jara.

translations.translation: El estilo que vistes. La cultura que llevas contigo.
translations.note: Region-neutral and idiomatic.

translations.translation: S’istile chi bestis. Sa cultura chi portas.
translations.note: Limba Sarda Comuna-style broad standard; dialectal variants expected.

translations.translation: Стил који носиш. Култура коју носиш са собом.
translations.transliteration: Stil koji nosiš. Kultura koju nosiš sa sobom.
translations.note: Serbian Cyrillic selected; Latin script equally standard.

translations.translation: Gqoka sitayela sakho. Phatsa lisiko lakho.
translations.note: Standard style loan; figurative phatsa needs native review.

translations.translation: Gaya nu dianggo. Budaya nu dijungjung.
translations.note: Carry transcreated as ‘uphold,’ avoiding physical-hauling sense.

translations.translation: Vaa mtindo wako. Beba utamaduni wako.
translations.note: Native core vocabulary; concise imperative slogan.

translations.translation: Stilen du bär. Kulturen du bär med dig.
translations.note: Idiomatic parallel use of bär.

translations.translation: A fa’a’ahu i tō ’oe huru. A amo i tō ’oe peu.
translations.note: Style as appearance and culture as custom; orthography and idiom need native review.

translations.translation: நீ அணியும் பாணி. நீ ஏந்தும் பண்பாடு.
translations.transliteration: Nī aṇiyum pāṇi. Nī ēntum paṇpāṭu.
translations.note: Natural balanced clauses; ஏந்தும் conveys bearing and embodying.

translations.translation: Син кигән стиль. Син үзең белән йөрткән мәдәният.
translations.transliteration: Sin kigän stil. Sin üzeñ belän yörtkän mädäniyät.
translations.note: Informal singular; мәдәният preferred over Russian культура.

translations.translation: మీరు ధరించే శైలి. మీరు వెంట తీసుకెళ్లే సంస్కృతి.
translations.transliteration: Mīru dhariñcē śaili. Mīru veṇṭa tīsukeḷḷē saṃskṛti.
translations.note: Respectful మీరు; వెంట తీసుకెళ్లే conveys carrying with you.

translations.translation: Услубе, ки мепӯшӣ. Фарҳанге, ки бо худ мебарӣ.
translations.transliteration: Uslube, ki mepūshī. Farhange, ki bo khud mebarī.
translations.note: Informal singular; бо худ preserves identity metaphor.

translations.translation: Estilong suot mo. Kulturang taglay mo.
translations.note: Taglay means possess or embody; established estilo and kultura retained.

translations.translation: สไตล์ที่คุณสวมใส่ วัฒนธรรมที่คุณพกพา
translations.transliteration: Satai thi khun suam sai. Watthanatham thi khun phok pha.
translations.note: Standard fashion term สไตล์; natural Thai slogan spacing.

translations.translation: ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་གྱོན་པའི་བཟོ་ལྟ། ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་འཁྱེར་བའི་རིག་གཞུང་།
translations.transliteration: khyod kyis gyon pa'i bzo lta/ khyod kyis 'khyer ba'i rig gzhung /
translations.note: Standard Written Tibetan in Uchen; slogan rhythm merits native review.

translations.translation: ቅዲ ትኽደኖ። ባህሊ ትስከሞ።
translations.transliteration: Qədi təḵədano. Bahli təsəkamo.
translations.note: Masculine singular generic; regional native review advised.

translations.translation: Ko e founga teunga ʻokú ke tui. Ko e anga fakafonua ʻokú ke fua.
translations.note: Native paraphrase ‘way of dressing’; fua is the candidate for bearing culture; native review remains required.

translations.translation: Setaele se o se aparang. Setso se o se tshotse.
translations.note: Standard adapted setaele; parallel relative concords.

translations.translation: Xitayili lexi u xi ambalaka. Ndhavuko lowu u wu rhwalaka.
translations.note: Adapted xitayili; class concords preserve parallel syntax.

translations.translation: Geýýän stiliň. Özüň bilen göterýän medeniýetiň.
translations.note: Informal singular; explicit ‘with you’ prevents physical-only reading.

translations.translation: Giydiğin tarz. Taşıdığın kültür.
translations.note: Informal singular; native-standard tarz creates clean balance.

translations.translation: Style a wohyɛ. Amammerɛ a wosoa.
translations.note: Asante Twi; style retained as routine contemporary loan; native campaign review required.

translations.translation: سىز كىيگەن ئۇسلۇب. سىز ئېلىپ يۈرگەن مەدەنىيەت.
translations.transliteration: Siz kiygen uslub. Siz ëlip yürgen medeniyet.
translations.note: Respectful سىز; standard Arabic-script Uyghur.

translations.translation: Стиль, який носиш. Культура, яку несеш.
translations.transliteration: Styl, yakyi nosysh. Kultura, yaku nesesh.
translations.note: Pronoun omitted; носиш and несеш create deliberate sound balance.

translations.translation: انداز جو آپ پہنتے ہیں۔ ثقافت جو آپ ساتھ لیے چلتے ہیں۔
translations.transliteration: Andāz jo āp pahante hain. Saqāfat jo āp sāth liye chalte hain.
translations.note: Formal آپ; ساتھ لیے چلتے ہیں expresses culture carried through life.

translations.translation: Kiyadigan uslubing. Olib yuradigan madaniyating.
translations.note: Informal singular; matching habitual participles.

translations.translation: Tshitaila tshine wa ambara. Mvelele ine wa hwala.
translations.note: Adapted tshitaila; noun-class concord and campaign register need native review.

translations.translation: Phong cách bạn mặc. Văn hóa bạn mang theo.
translations.note: Natural elliptical advertising syntax; mang theo means carry along.

translations.translation: Maget, keli lenlabol. Kuliv, keli polol.
translations.note: Modern Volapük; accusative relative keli required for both objects.

translations.translation: Arddull rydych chi’n ei wisgo. Diwylliant rydych chi’n ei gario.
translations.note: Neutral formal or plural chi; masculine mutations checked.

translations.translation: Li stîle ki ti poites. Li culteure ki ti moennes avou twè.
translations.note: Rfondou walon chosen; strong regional variation makes native review essential.

translations.translation: Melokaan wi ngay sol. Cosaan wi ngay yor.
translations.note: Melokaan means look or style; cosaan foregrounds heritage and roots.

translations.translation: Isimbo osinxibayo. Inkcubeko oyithweleyo.
translations.note: Parallel relative clauses; object concords si- and yi-.

translations.translation: דער סטיל וואָס דו טראָגסט. די קולטור וואָס דו טראָגסט מיט זיך.
translations.transliteration: Der stil vos du trogst. Di kultur vos du trogst mit zikh.
translations.note: Informal singular; standard YIVO orthography.

translations.translation: Àrà tí o wọ̀. Àṣà tí o gbé.
translations.note: Full tone marks; gbé intentionally supports carry and live double meaning.

translations.translation: Yiengh mwngz daenj. Vwnzva mwngz dawz.
translations.note: Standard Zhuang, Wuming or Yongbei-based 1982 Latin orthography; expert review essential.

translations.translation: Isitayela osigqokayo. Isiko olithwalayo.
translations.note: Parallel relative clauses; object concords si- and li-.
